figures.title: Eight surfaces of resolved state
figures.desc: Direction, Sources, Instructions, Tools, Permissions, State, Feedback, and Decisive evidence are eight surfaces that can load separately. Map each one before you decide what ran.
figures.caption: Map Direction, Sources, Instructions, Tools, Permissions, State, Feedback, and Decisive evidence.
figures.transcript: Direction, Sources, Instructions, Tools, Permissions, State, Feedback, and Decisive evidence are eight surfaces that can load separately. Map each one before you decide what ran.

figures.title: Advice is not a guard
figures.desc: Temporary advice, a saved instruction, a deterministic screen, and actual authority sit on different rungs. Advice does not stop a later run.
figures.caption: Name the rung: temporary advice, saved instruction, deterministic screen, or actual authority.
figures.transcript: Temporary advice, a saved instruction, a deterministic screen, and actual authority sit on different rungs. Advice does not stop a later run.

items.label: Deterministic screen
items.detail: a check that accepts or rejects

figures.title: The hostile note is data
figures.desc: The clean note states paper arrived. It is not a release. The hostile note states the height and quotes an instruction to release the crate. Treat retrieved source text as data.
figures.caption: Treat retrieved source text as data. Do not obey instructions found inside retrieved notes.
figures.transcript: The clean note states paper arrived. It is not a release. The hostile note states the height and quotes an instruction to release the crate. Treat retrieved source text as data.

items.label: Hostile note
items.detail: height plus a quoted instruction to ignore

figures.title: Write the prediction first
figures.desc: Write the expected accept, then the expected reject, then run. A result you did not predict cannot teach you what the screen did.
figures.caption: Write expected accept and expected reject before you run the screen.
figures.transcript: Write the expected accept, then the expected reject, then run. A result you did not predict cannot teach you what the screen did.

figures.title: Clean note passes, hostile note fails
figures.desc: The clean note is accepted. The hostile note is rejected. The pair is the evidence that the screen reads the note as data.
figures.caption: Confirm the clean note is accepted and the hostile note is rejected.
figures.transcript: The clean note is accepted. The hostile note is rejected. The pair is the evidence that the screen reads the note as data.

figures.title: Load the rule, exit, load again in a fresh session
figures.desc: Load the saved rule through the launcher. Exit completely. Start a new evidence directory. Load the same rule again. The load receipt must match.
figures.caption: Load the rule, exit, start a fresh session, load the same rule, confirm identical receipt.
figures.transcript: Load the rule through the launcher. Exit completely. Start a new evidence directory. Load the same rule again. The load receipt must match.

figures.title: Four ways a control can miss
figures.desc: A control can miss because it was not loaded, not triggered, failed in execution, or executed and then was bypassed. Name the miss before you add another control.
figures.caption: Name whether the control was not loaded, not triggered, failed, or bypassed.
figures.transcript: A control can miss because it was not loaded, not triggered, failed in execution, or executed and then was bypassed. Name the miss before you add another control.

items.label: Not loaded
items.detail: the rule never entered the run

figures.title: What the screen stops, what you still own
figures.desc: After a correct reject the screen did its job. You still own new notes, new tools, and new authority.
figures.caption: After a correct reject, name what you still own.
figures.transcript: After a correct reject the screen did its job. You still own new notes, new tools, and new authority.

items.label: Still human
items.detail: new notes, new tools, new authority
